name: ai-prompt-schedule
description: Schedule prompts for AI desktop apps and VS Code chat extensions

ai-prompt-schedule.defaultProvider.description: Preselected agent when creating a scheduled message. Each schedule can target a different agent.

ai-prompt-schedule.providers.codex.enabl.description: Allow scheduling messages for the OpenAI Codex VS Code extension.

ai-prompt-schedule.providers.codexDeskto.description: Allow scheduling messages for the active Codex Desktop window on Windows and macOS.

ai-prompt-schedule.providers.claude.enab.description: Allow scheduling messages for Claude Code.

ai-prompt-schedule.providers.claudeDeskt.description: Allow scheduling messages for the active Claude Desktop app on Windows and macOS.

ai-prompt-schedule.providers.gemini.enab.description: Allow scheduling messages for Gemini Code Assist.

ai-prompt-schedule.providers.copilot.ena.description: Allow scheduling messages for GitHub Copilot Chat.

ai-prompt-schedule.providers.chatgpt.ena.description: Allow scheduling messages for the active ChatGPT Desktop window on Windows and macOS.

ai-prompt-schedule.providers.codex.focus.description: VS Code command used to focus the current Codex chat.

ai-prompt-schedule.providers.claude.focu.description: VS Code command used to focus the current Claude Code input.

ai-prompt-schedule.providers.gemini.focu.description: VS Code command used to focus the current Gemini chat.

ai-prompt-schedule.providers.copilot.foc.description: VS Code command used to open GitHub Copilot Chat.

ai-prompt-schedule.providers.cline.focus.description: VS Code command used to focus the current Cline chat.

ai-prompt-schedule.focusChatOnReminder.description: Focus the selected agent's current chat when a scheduled message is due.

ai-prompt-schedule.automaticSend.description: On Windows or macOS, paste the scheduled prompt into the focused agent chat and press Enter. macOS requires Accessibility and Automation permissions; disable for clipboard-only reminders.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
